name: P8 — Direction-specific rubric
description: P8: completeness and scientific quality under the accompanying task specification. Integrity is evaluated in the separate integrity rubric.

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does proposal/report.pdf exist with substantive content (full sections, not a placeholder)?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check: stat proposal/report.pdf; open and verify it has motivation, specification-encoder method, experimental setup, results, attribution, mechanism, failure analysis, and conclusion sections.

yes.description: report.pdf exists and contains a substantive paper.
yes.criteria: PDF exists, parses cleanly, and contains Introduction / Method (specification encoder + IC/BC representation) / Experimental Setup / Results / Attribution / Mechanism / Failure analysis / Conclusion sections (or equivalents) with non-placeholder content.

no.criteria: PDF absent, malformed, or contains only placeholder text.

leaves.question: Does proposal/logs/ exist and contain non-empty run records?
leaves.evidence: List proposal/logs/; confirm per-run records with per-specification and aggregate errors, seeds, and budgets.

yes.criteria: proposal/logs/ contains per-run records for the baseline, naive control, and structured-encoder runs.

no.criteria: proposal/logs/ absent or contains no substantive run records.

leaves.question: Is there a timestamped specification-encoder plan file (proposal/code/specification_encoder_plan.*) written before the comparison?
leaves.evidence: Check proposal/code/specification_encoder_plan.{py,md,json}; confirm it states the encoder design, IC/BC representations, splits, reference sources, weight/hyperparameter protocol, and delta, with a timestamp predating the run logs.

yes.description: Plan file present and timestamped before results.
yes.criteria: Plan states the encoder/representation, the splits (trained/held-out ICs, IC families, BC types, combinations, PDE families), the reference sources, the weight/hyperparameter protocol, and delta; its timestamp predates the comparison logs.

no.criteria: No plan file, or it postdates the comparison logs, or it omits the encoder/representation/splits/delta.

leaves.question: Are the coefficient-only P2INN baseline runs AND the naive-control runs present in the logs?
leaves.evidence: Confirm proposal/logs/ has both the coefficient-only baseline and the naive (IC/BC-as-raw-inputs) control runs on the declared families/splits.

yes.criteria: Both the coefficient-only baseline and the matched naive control have logged runs on the declared families/splits.

no.criteria: The coefficient-only baseline or the naive-control runs are missing from the logs on one or more declared families/splits.

leaves.question: Are the structured-encoder core generalization runs (unseen IC parameters, unseen IC function family, unseen coefficient x IC combinations) present in the logs?
leaves.evidence: Confirm logged runs evaluating the structured encoder on each held-out core set.

yes.criteria: The structured encoder has logged evaluations on the unseen-IC-parameter, unseen-IC-family, and unseen-combination held-out sets.

no.criteria: One or more of the core held-out evaluations is missing from the logs.

leaves.question: Are the conditioning-removed / shuffled-IC ablation runs present in the logs?
leaves.evidence: Confirm logged runs for the ablation that removes/shuffles the IC (or BC) representation.

yes.criteria: The conditioning-removed / shuffled ablation has logged runs on the relevant held-out sets.

no.criteria: No conditioning-removed / shuffled ablation is logged.

leaves.question: If out-of-distribution / generalization-boundary work is claimed in the paper, are the corresponding runs present in the logs? (This work is OPTIONAL; if not attempted, its absence is not a missing deliverable.)
leaves.evidence: Confirm logged runs sweeping a generalization axis to failure, plus the discrimination runs (the failing setting retrained at increased capacity/epochs/collocation and against a converged reference).

yes.criteria: The boundary sweep and the fundamental-vs-undertrained discrimination runs are present in the logs.

no.criteria: The boundary sweep or the discrimination runs are missing from the logs.

leaves.question: If the boundary-condition stretch is claimed in the paper, are its runs (>=2 BC types, with the authored non-periodic reference) present in the logs? (OPTIONAL; if not attempted, absence is not a missing deliverable.)
leaves.evidence: Confirm logged BC-conditioned runs across >=2 BC types plus the non-periodic reference-validation records.

yes.criteria: Logged runs cover >=2 BC types and include the non-periodic reference-solution validation records.

no.criteria: No BC-conditioned runs across >=2 BC types are logged, or the non-periodic reference records are absent.

leaves.question: If the PDE-type-breadth stretch is claimed in the paper, are its runs (>=2 PDE families jointly supported, held-out composition transfer) present in the logs? (OPTIONAL; if not attempted, absence is not a missing deliverable.)
leaves.evidence: Confirm logged runs for a single shared model across >=2 PDE families and the held-out combined-specification transfer.

yes.criteria: Logged runs show a single shared model evaluated across >=2 PDE families and at least one held-out combined-specification transfer.

no.criteria: No multi-PDE-family runs, or no held-out composition transfer, are logged.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain the primary results table labelled tab:main_results?
leaves.evidence: Search report.tex/pdf for \label{tab:main_results}.

yes.criteria: A table with \label{tab:main_results} reports rel-L2 (and absolute) per method per family/axis on the seen-specification and held-out sets.

no.criteria: No table labelled tab:main_results is present.

leaves.question: Are the error-vs-specification curves across the trained and held-out region present?
leaves.evidence: Confirm figures plotting error vs the varying specification (IC parameter / BC / family) for the baseline, naive control, and structured encoder.

yes.criteria: The paper plots error vs the varying specification across the trained and held-out region for the compared methods.

no.criteria: No error-vs-specification curves are present.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain a Methodology section specifying the specification encoder and the evaluation?
leaves.evidence: Confirm a Methodology (or equivalent) section describing the encoder, the IC/BC representation, and the evaluation.

yes.criteria: A Methodology section specifies the specification encoder, the IC/BC representation, and the evaluation protocol.

no.criteria: No Methodology section, or it omits the encoder/representation/evaluation.

leaves.question: Is proposal/codebase_notes.md present and non-trivial?
leaves.evidence: Open proposal/codebase_notes.md; confirm it documents what was inspected/reused in code/P2INN and how the extension relates.

yes.criteria: codebase_notes.md documents the inspected/reused P2INN components and how the extended encoder and any authored solver relate to them.

no.criteria: codebase_notes.md is absent or trivial.

leaves.question: Is proposal/attempts_log.md present when the paper claims partial or unresolved work?
leaves.evidence: If the paper claims any attempted-but-incomplete item (e.g. the honest-negative transfer), confirm attempts_log.md documents it.

yes.description: Attempts log present (or no partial work claimed).
yes.criteria: attempts_log.md is present and documents unresolved work, or the paper claims no partial work.

no.description: Attempts log missing despite partial work.
no.criteria: The paper claims partial/unresolved work but attempts_log.md is absent.

method_specification.title: Method specification
method_specification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the specification encoder (the IC/BC-conditioned extension) fully stated in the Methodology / plan before the empirical results?
leaves.evidence: Confirm the encoder design and representation appear in the plan/Methodology ahead of the results.

yes.criteria: The extended encoder and IC/BC representation are fully described before the empirical results are reported.

no.criteria: The encoder/representation is introduced only alongside or after the results.

leaves.question: Is the IC/BC representation (defining parameters, basis coefficients, sampled values, or learned function encoder) specified precisely enough to reimplement?
leaves.evidence: Check that the representation form, dimensionality, and how it is ingested by the encoder are stated.

fully_specified.criteria: The IC/BC representation form, dimensionality, sampling/basis choice, and ingestion into the encoder are stated precisely enough to reimplement from the paper.

mostly_specified.criteria: The representation is mostly specified but a minor detail (a sampling grid, a normalization, the exact concat point) requires reading the code.

qualitative.criteria: The representation is described only qualitatively, without a precise form sufficient for reimplementation.

leaves.question: Does the paper state where the IC/BC representation enters (through the parameter-encoder path into the held-fixed concatenation), consistent with the held-fixed decoder?
leaves.evidence: Confirm the paper states the conditioning enters through h_param into the concat, not by redesigning the decoder.

yes.criteria: The paper states the IC/BC enters through the parameter-encoder path (h_param) into the held-fixed concatenation.

no.criteria: The paper does not state where the specification is injected, or is ambiguous about whether the decoder was altered.

leaves.question: Does the paper state a seen-specification validation protocol for any introduced hyperparameter (encoder capacity, representation hyperparameters)?
leaves.evidence: Confirm hyperparameters are tuned on a seen-specification split, stated in the paper.

yes.criteria: The paper states that introduced hyperparameters are selected on a seen-specification validation split, never on a held-out set.

no.criteria: The paper does not state a seen-specification selection protocol for its hyperparameters.

leaves.question: Is the conditioning design motivated with reference to the conditional-neural-field / operator-learning / IC-BC-conditioned-PINN literature?
leaves.evidence: Check the motivation cites relevant specification-conditioning / operator-learning work.

yes.criteria: The design is motivated with reference to the relevant specification-conditioning / operator-learning / parametric-surrogate literature.

no.criteria: The motivation is not grounded in the relevant literature.

baseline_and_control.title: Baseline and control
baseline_and_control.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the coefficient-only P2INN baseline reproduced in the held-fixed setup with paper-consistent seen-specification accuracy?
leaves.evidence: Check the baseline's logged seen-specification error is reproduced (paper-consistent) in the held-fixed setup.

yes.criteria: The coefficient-only P2INN baseline is trained in the held-fixed setup and its seen-specification accuracy is reproduced and logged (paper-consistent).

no.criteria: The coefficient-only baseline is absent, not reproduced, or its seen-specification accuracy is not established.

leaves.question: Is the naive control (IC/BC as raw extra inputs) defined and matched in added capacity to the structured encoder?
leaves.evidence: Confirm the naive control injects the IC/BC as raw inputs with the SAME added capacity as the structured encoder, and comes from logged runs.

matched.criteria: The naive control feeds the IC/BC as raw extra inputs with the same added encoder capacity as the structured design, from the agent's own logged runs.

unmatched_capacity.criteria: A naive control exists but its added capacity does not match the structured encoder, so the attribution comparison is not fair.

absent.criteria: No matched naive control is defined, so the structured-vs-naive attribution cannot be established.

leaves.question: Are architectural changes restricted to the specification encoder's input representation and internal architecture, retaining its 50-dimensional output, the reference coordinate encoder/decoder, concatenation injection, and original modvec architecture and coefficient/coordinate inputs? Are base-loss terms/weights and headline comparison budgets held fixed?
leaves.evidence: Inspect model.py and executed configurations for every comparison arm. IC/BC enters only through h_param. Joint training of reference subnetworks and float-valued encoder input plumbing remain allowed; fixed architecture does not mean frozen weights. The separately specified optional under-training diagnostic may increase encoder capacity/epochs/collocation, not decoder/coordinate-encoder architecture.

yes.description: Only the permitted encoder design changes; the output width, concatenation and modvec input interfaces, decoder/coordinate-encoder architectures, base loss, and required headline budgets remain fixed. Encoder capacity is matched to the naive control.
yes.criteria: Only the permitted encoder design changes; the output width, concatenation and modvec input interfaces, decoder/coordinate-encoder architectures, base loss, and required headline budgets remain fixed. Encoder capacity is matched to the naive control.

no.description: A prohibited architecture, injection, output-width, modvec-input, loss, or headline-budget change occurs. Motivation, disclosure, ablation, or matched compute does not exempt an architecture violation. The explicitly allowed diagnostic budget increases alone are not violations.
no.criteria: A prohibited architecture, injection, output-width, modvec-input, loss, or headline-budget change occurs. Motivation, disclosure, ablation, or matched compute does not exempt an architecture violation. The explicitly allowed diagnostic budget increases alone are not violations.

core_result.title: Core result -- joint coefficient x IC generalization
core_result.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the structured encoder generalize to unseen IC parameters and unseen coefficient x IC combinations, beating BOTH the coefficient-only baseline and the naive control by at least delta?
leaves.evidence: Compare held-out (unseen IC parameters, unseen combinations) rel-L2 for structured vs baseline and vs naive control against the pre-registered delta.

clear.criteria: On the unseen-IC-parameter and unseen-combination held-out sets, the structured encoder reduces mean rel-L2 by >= delta relative to both the coefficient-only baseline and the naive control. The headline IC axis must be NON-TRIVIAL: at least one core held-out IC axis is on a family with non-linear IC-to-solution dependence (reaction, reaction-diffusion, or CDR), where the naive control is a genuine competitor -- an axis achievable by a single linear operator on the initial condition (pure convection/diffusion amplitude scaling) does not by itself qualify as a clear demonstration.

marginal.criteria: A positive but sub-delta improvement over the baseline or the naive control on the core held-out sets.

no.criteria: No improvement (<=0) over the baseline or the naive control on the core held-out sets.

leaves.question: Does the structured encoder generalize to an unseen IC FUNCTION FAMILY (a functional family held out of training), beating BOTH the coefficient-only baseline (at its trained IC) and the naive control by at least delta?
leaves.evidence: Evaluate the held-out-function-family set (e.g. train sinusoids, test Gaussians/polynomials); compare structured vs the coefficient-only baseline AND vs the naive control against delta.

clear.criteria: On the held-out IC function family, the structured encoder reduces mean rel-L2 by >= delta over BOTH the coefficient-only baseline (at its trained IC as the reachable reference) and the naive control, separated from seed noise -- genuine functional generalization, not parameter interpolation.

marginal.criteria: A positive but sub-delta improvement over the baseline or the naive control on the held-out IC function family.

absent.criteria: No held-out IC function family is evaluated (only unseen parameters of a trained family).

leaves.question: Does the extended model preserve seen-specification accuracy (original coefficient-only setting) versus the reference P2INN baseline?
leaves.evidence: Compare per-coefficient seen-specification rel-L2 of the extended model vs the baseline against the tolerance (<=10% relative or 0.005 absolute, per-coefficient).

preserved.criteria: The extended model's seen-specification error is within tolerance of the baseline per-coefficient (<=10% relative or 0.005 absolute rel-L2, whichever is larger).

minor_regression.criteria: Seen-specification error exceeds the tolerance slightly, but small enough that the generalization gain plausibly dominates.

regressed.criteria: Seen-specification accuracy meaningfully regresses -- the generalization was bought by wrecking the original capability.

conditioning_attribution.title: Conditioning attribution
conditioning_attribution.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: On the held-out IC sets, does the structured encoder beat the matched naive control by at least delta?
leaves.evidence: Compare structured vs naive control on the held-out IC sets against delta and the seed-noise band.

beats.criteria: The structured encoder beats the matched naive control on the held-out IC sets by >= delta, separated from seed noise.

ties.criteria: The structured encoder only ties the matched naive control on the held-out IC sets -- the gain is from adding raw inputs, not from structured encoding.

not_tested.criteria: No head-to-head structured-vs-naive comparison on the held-out IC sets is reported.

leaves.question: Does a conditioning-removed / shuffled-IC ablation degrade held-out generalization toward the baseline (showing the model USES the IC/BC input)?
leaves.evidence: Run the ablation (shuffle/constant IC representation); confirm held-out accuracy degrades appropriately.

degrades_appropriately.criteria: Removing/shuffling the IC (or BC) representation degrades held-out accuracy toward the baseline by a non-trivial, noise-separated amount (the degradation exceeds the pooled seed standard deviation), demonstrating the model genuinely conditions on the specification.

no_effect.criteria: The ablation has no effect on held-out accuracy, so the model is not actually using the specification input (a degenerate/ignored encoding).

leaves.question: Is the encoding non-degenerate -- the latent still distinguishes ICs/BCs and the encoding is not collapsed or ignored?
leaves.evidence: Check the latent distinguishes distinct ICs/BCs (a diagnostic) and preserved seen-specification accuracy.

non_degenerate.criteria: The latent distinguishes distinct ICs/BCs and the ablation degrades -- the model genuinely conditions on the specification.

weak_evidence.criteria: Non-degeneracy rests only on preserved accuracy without a direct check that the latent distinguishes ICs/BCs, or the check is qualitative-only.

degenerate.criteria: The encoding is collapsed toward a constant or otherwise ignored, so any reported gain is a degenerate artifact.

boundary_conditions.title: Stretch S1 -- boundary conditions (optional differentiator)
boundary_conditions.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only if boundary-condition conditioning is attempted; not a required gate): Does a single model condition on and generalize across >=2 boundary-condition types, including to a held-out BC configuration, beating the naive control?
leaves.evidence: Confirm >=2 BC types (incl. a non-periodic one) conditioned and evaluated, with held-out-BC generalization beating the naive control.

clear.criteria: A single model conditions on >=2 BC types (incl. a non-periodic one) and generalizes to a held-out BC configuration, beating the naive control by >= delta separated from seed noise.

present_but_weak.criteria: >=2 BC types are conditioned and evaluated and the held-out-BC generalization is noise-separated over the naive control, but the margin is modest / narrow (short of the full delta).

within_noise.criteria: >=2 BC types are conditioned/evaluated, but the held-out-BC generalization over the naive control lies inside the seed-uncertainty band or is only qualitative -- no trustworthy held-out-BC generalization (the stretch statistical bar mirrors the core's).

single_bc_only.criteria: Only a single boundary-condition type is conditioned/evaluated -- the BC stretch is not delivered.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only if the boundary-condition stretch is attempted; not a required gate): Is the authored non-periodic reference solver validated (convergence under refinement AND agreement with the spectral reference on the periodic overlap)?
leaves.evidence: Check the reference-validation records for the non-periodic BC solver.

validated.criteria: The authored non-periodic reference solver is validated: it converges under refinement and agrees with the spectral reference on the periodic overlap.

unvalidated.criteria: The non-periodic reference used to measure BC generalization is not validated (no convergence / no periodic cross-check), so the BC result cannot be trusted.

pde_type_breadth.title: Stretch S2 -- PDE-type breadth (optional differentiator)
pde_type_breadth.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only if PDE-type breadth is attempted; not a required gate): Does a single shared model jointly support >=2 PDE families, each evaluated on unseen specifications?
leaves.evidence: Confirm one shared model is trained/evaluated across >=2 PDE families from {convection, diffusion, reaction, reaction-diffusion, CDR}.

two_or_more.criteria: A single shared model jointly supports >=2 PDE families, each evaluated on unseen coefficient/IC/BC specifications.

single_family.criteria: Only a single PDE family is supported -- the PDE-type-breadth stretch is not delivered.

absent.criteria: No multi-PDE-family joint support is attempted.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only if the PDE-type-breadth stretch is attempted; not a required gate): Does the paper report the number and diversity of PDE families (and BC types / IC families) jointly supported?
leaves.evidence: Confirm an explicit breadth summary (counts + diversity) is reported.

yes.criteria: The paper reports the number and diversity of IC families, BC types, and PDE families jointly supported.

no.criteria: The breadth counts / diversity are not reported explicitly.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only if the PDE-type-breadth stretch is attempted; not a required gate): Is transfer to a held-out combined specification evaluated, and is the never-trained-PDE-type transfer reported (positively or as an honest negative)?
leaves.evidence: Confirm a held-out (coefficient x IC x BC) composition transfer is DEMONSTRATED; separately check whether transfer to a never-trained PDE TYPE is positive or a disclosed honest negative. Distinguish a demonstrated-but-modest composition transfer from a failed one.

transfers.criteria: Transfer to a held-out combined (coefficient x IC x BC) specification is demonstrated, clearing the margin over the naive control separated from seed noise; transfer to a never-trained PDE type is positive or additionally reported.

composition_transfer_modest.criteria: The held-out combined-specification transfer is demonstrated (noise-separated over the naive control) but modest, short of the full margin -- a quality weakness, not a gate failure.

composition_transfer_failed.criteria: The held-out combined-specification transfer was evaluated but does not transfer / does not clear the margin -- the required composition transfer is unmet (NOT covered by the never-trained-type valve).

not_evaluated.criteria: No held-out combined-specification transfer is evaluated at all.

negative_result_characterized.description: Held-out composition transfers, but never-trained-PDE-type transfer fails and is scientifically characterized.
negative_result_characterized.criteria: The required composition-transfer evidence for this optional stretch is present; the separate never-trained-type transfer is negative with mechanism analysis and documented attempts. This is a scientific outcome, not an integrity finding.

statistical_rigor.title: Statistical rigor
statistical_rigor.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Are the headline results reported across multiple seeds with an uncertainty measure?
leaves.evidence: Confirm >1 seed and error bars / std on the headline comparisons.

yes.criteria: Headline comparisons are reported over multiple seeds with error bars / standard deviations.

no.criteria: Headline results are single-seed or reported without an uncertainty measure.

leaves.question: Are the core generalization margins (over baseline and naive control) statistically separated from seed noise?
leaves.evidence: Compare each core margin against the pooled seed standard deviation; check the per-specification curves separate.

separated.criteria: Each core margin exceeds the pooled seed standard deviation and the per-specification curves separate.

not_characterized.criteria: Seeds are reported but the margin-vs-uncertainty comparison is not made.

within_noise.criteria: A core margin lies inside the reported seed-uncertainty band -- the claimed win is not separated from noise.

mechanism_analysis.title: Mechanism analysis
mechanism_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain a mechanism analysis of WHY the extended encoding generalizes?
leaves.evidence: Confirm a mechanism subsection analysing what the encoder represents and how error grows with specification novelty.

yes.criteria: The paper contains a mechanism analysis of what the specification encoder represents and why it generalizes.

no.criteria: The paper has no mechanism analysis of the generalization.

leaves.question: How deep is the mechanism analysis?
leaves.evidence: Assess whether the analysis connects the representation (latent structure / distance-in-specification) to the generalization behavior, beyond restating errors.

deep.criteria: The analysis quantitatively connects what the encoder represents (latent geometry, distance-in-specification) to where it generalizes and fails, and predicts it.

moderate.criteria: The analysis identifies the representation as the driver but does not tie the diagnostic quantitatively to the error behavior.

shallow.criteria: The analysis restates the error results without connecting the representation to the generalization.

absent.criteria: No substantive mechanism reasoning is present.

generalization_boundary.title: Generalization boundary / OOD evaluation (optional differentiator)
generalization_boundary.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (mapping the full boundary is not a required gate; the required soft version is to evaluate OOD and, if a failure regime appears, analyze its cause): Does the paper map the generalization boundary -- sweep at least one generalization axis (IC parameter/frequency/amplitude, IC family, BC, or coefficient) OUTWARD to the point where the structured encoder stops generalizing, not only reporting settings where it succeeds?
leaves.evidence: Look for error-vs-specification sweeps that continue past the success region into a failure region; confirm the boundary (the transition) is located.

mapped.criteria: At least one generalization axis is swept outward until generalization fails, locating the boundary between the success and failure regions.

partial.criteria: A sweep approaches but does not clearly reach a failure region, or only one axis is mapped where several were declared.

absent.criteria: Only success settings are reported; no axis is pushed to failure, so the boundary is never approached.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only when the boundary-mapping / fundamental-failure work is attempted; not a required gate): Does the paper designate at least one SPECIFIC held-out setting where the structured encoder fails to generalize, with a criterion for what counts as failure stated before the result?
leaves.evidence: Confirm a named failing setting (a specific IC family/parameter/BC/coefficient region) with a pre-stated failure criterion.

designated.criteria: At least one specific failing setting is named with a pre-stated failure criterion.

vague.criteria: A failure region is gestured at but no specific setting or pre-stated criterion is given.

absent.criteria: No specific failure setting is designated.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only when a failure regime is designated as part of the attempted boundary-mapping work; not a required gate): Is the designated failing setting a MEANINGFUL, non-degenerate specification -- a plausibly-queried IC/BC/coefficient a modest step beyond the trained span -- rather than an adversarial strawman chosen only to break the encoder?
leaves.evidence: Judge whether the failing setting is a realistic UQ/design query (within or modestly past the reference IC zoo's amplitude/offset/frequency/Gaussian-width span) vs. a pathological setting (amplitude/frequency far beyond any realistic query, a sub-grid feature the 256-point grid cannot resolve, a non-differentiable/ill-posed IC, or a nonsensical BC).

meaningful.criteria: The failing setting is a plausibly-queried specification, a natural extension a modest step beyond the trained span.

borderline.criteria: The failing setting is somewhat extreme or somewhat trivial -- a real specification but at the edge of what anyone would query.

degenerate.criteria: The failing setting is pathological or chosen only to make the encoder break (amplitude/frequency far beyond any realistic query, a sub-grid feature, a non-differentiable/ill-posed IC, or a nonsensical BC), so the 'boundary' is a strawman.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (establishing a fundamental failure is not a required gate; the soft requirement is only that, where feasible, an observed failure be distinguished from under-training / reference artifacts -- assessed only when this discrimination is attempted): Is the designated failure shown to be a FUNDAMENTAL, METHOD-SPECIFIC limit of the representation / distance-in-specification -- persisting under a SUBSTANTIAL (non-token) increase in the parameter-encoder-path capacity, epochs, and collocation and against a converged reference, and NOT an artifact any method shares (a linear-IC-family sweep) or a reference-solver artifact?
leaves.evidence: Confirm the discrimination run: the failing setting retrained with a substantial (~2x-4x), pre-stated increase in the parameter-encoder-path width, epochs, and collocation (the held-fixed decoder/coordinate encoder are NOT enlarged) and evaluated against a converged reference; check the failure persists. Confirm it is method-specific (on a non-linear-IC family, OR the matched naive control does NOT share the failure) and, for operator-split families (reaction-diffusion, CDR) at a sharper/higher-frequency IC, that the reference is spot-checked converged AT THE FAILING SETTING (halve dt / double nx, change < delta).

discriminated.criteria: The failure persists under a SUBSTANTIAL, pre-stated increase (~2x-4x on each of parameter-encoder-path width, epochs, and collocation -- a clearly non-token step, decoder/coordinate encoder held fixed) and against a converged reference; AND it is method-specific (the designated axis is on a non-linear-IC family reaction/RD/CDR, OR the matched naive control does not exhibit the same failure); AND, for operator-split families at a sharper/higher-frequency IC, the reference is spot-checked converged at the failing setting. Established as a fundamental representation / specification-distance limit.

confound_untested.criteria: The failure is asserted fundamental but the confounds were not properly tested: the capacity/epochs/collocation increase is absent or token (below the ~2x floor), or the reference is not shown converged at the failing setting (notably for operator-split families at a sharp/high-frequency IC), so it could be under-training or a reference-solver artifact.

shown_undertrained.criteria: The discrimination shows the failure vanishes under the substantial capacity/epochs/collocation increase (or a converged reference), so the designated setting is not a fundamental boundary and no genuinely fundamental setting was established.

shared_family_artifact.criteria: The sole designated failure is on a linearly-solvable convection/diffusion IC sweep (or the matched naive control shares the same failure), so the 'boundary' is a family-level artifact any method exhibits, not a limit of the structured encoding.

leaves.question: OPTIONAL DIFFERENTIATOR (assessed only when a failure regime is analyzed as part of the attempted boundary work; not a required gate): Is the observed failure EXPLAINED via the representation -- why the encoder cannot reach that setting (distance-in-specification from the trained set, a functional feature the encoding cannot represent), coherent with the mechanism analysis of why it generalizes?
leaves.evidence: Check the failure is explained through the latent/representation, not merely reported.

explained.criteria: The failure is explained through the representation / distance-in-specification, coherent with the mechanism analysis.

asserted.criteria: A reason is asserted but not connected to the representation or supported.

absent.criteria: The failure is reported without any mechanism explanation.

failure_analysis.title: Failure analysis
failure_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain a failure-analysis subsection?
leaves.evidence: Confirm an explicit failure-analysis subsection.

yes.criteria: The paper has an explicit failure-analysis subsection.

no.criteria: No failure-analysis subsection is present.

leaves.question: Are specific failure patterns (which ICs/BCs/families, how far the held-out reaches) identified?
leaves.evidence: Confirm specific failure patterns are identified, not a generic caveat.

yes.criteria: Specific failure patterns (which ICs/BCs/families do not generalize, how far the held-out sets reach) are identified.

no.criteria: No specific failure patterns are identified.

leaves.question: Are the identified failure patterns explained coherently in terms of the representation / specification novelty?

assessment_policy.scope: Completeness and scientific quality only: required artifacts, executed experimental coverage, reproducible methodology, mathematical/statistical validity, performance targets, and task-required analysis/writing.
assessment_policy.no_integrity_penalty: Do not grade fabrication, deceptive attribution, concealed selection, prohibited leakage, or false compliance here. Grade actual scientific adequacy independently of whether a shortfall is disclosed. Integrity evidence is assessed only in integrity_check_rubric.json.
assessment_policy.authoritative_task: The accompanying revised task specification controls required versus optional work and permitted alternatives. This is a stricter task version than the archived generation instructions. Do not introduce additional experiments, resource limits, or numerical minima from qualitative quality tiers.
assessment_policy.conditional_nodes: Respect applicability. Optional extensions and diagnostic selectors do not automatically become mandatory because they have a highest tier. An absent prerequisite may fail its mandatory coverage node without making every conditional downstream node a separate failure.
assessment_policy.inference: Insufficient scientific support is not itself dishonesty. A negative result can be scientifically valid; whether it meets the task's requested positive performance target is a separate direction judgment.
